verses.text: U Judas, u shakri u Jisu Khrist, bad shipara bad u Jakob, ha kito ïa kiba u Blei U la khot, kiba im ha ka jingieid u Blei u Kpa bad ha ka jingsumar sukher u Jisu Khrist.
To ka jingisynei, ka jingsuk bad ka jingieid kin nangroi kyrhai ha phi.

Nga la mut ban thoh sha phi, ko ba-ieid eh, shaphang ka jingpynim badei lang jong ngi. Hynrei mynta nga sngewdonkam ban thoh pynshlur ïa phi ban ïaleh tyngeh na ka bynta ka jingngeit, ïa kaba u Blei U la aiti shisien-ai ha ki paid jong U.

Ki ’riewsniew aïu re ki la wan rungtuh hapdeng jong phi. Ïa kine la mang la slem bah na ka bynta ka jingpynrem: ki jait briew kiba khlemblei, kiba woh dong ïa ka jingbha jong u Blei ban pynksan ïa la ki kam awria, bad kiba len ïa u Trai Kynrad bamarwei jong ngi, u Jisu Khrist.
Mynta nga kwah ban pynkynmaw ïa phi, wat la phi la tip bha ïa kane baroh, ba u Trai Uba la pyllait ïa u paidbah na ri Ijipt, U la pynduh hadien ïa kito kibym shym la ngeit.
Kynmaw ruh ïa ki angel ki bym shym la bat ïa la ka kyrdan, hynrei ki la ieh noh ïa la ka jaka: u Blei U la khum kynjri junom ïa ki ha ka jingdum jong ka ñiamra haduh ka sngi bishar ka bakhraw.
Ha kajuh ka rukom ïa ka Sodom bad Gomorra bad ïa ki shnong kiba markhap, kiba la leh nuti bad la kyrni ha ki jingkwahbrai ka doh, la pynshitom da ka ding bymjukut ban sah kum ka jingmaham ïa baroh.
Pynban ha kajuh ka rukom kine ki nongphohsniew kynsha ki pynbyrsieh ïa la ka doh, ki kyntait ïa ka bor jong u Blei, bad ki kren beiñ ïa ki angel bneng.

Wat u Mikhael Arkhangel hi um shym la leh kumta. Mynba u la ïapyn-eh bad u soitan shaphang ka met jong u Moses, um shym shlan ban da rai kynnoh beiñ halor jong u, hynrei u la shu ong, “To u Trai Un kynhied ïa me !”
Hynrei kine ki briew pat de ki kren beiñ naphang ïa kaba kim shemphang, katba la pynjot ïa ki da kiei kiei kiba ki tip na la ki tipthuh, kiba wat ki mrad bym sngewthuh ruh ki don.
Kordit ïa ki ! Ki ïaid kumba leh u Kaiñ. Ban ïoh spah, kim kheiñ ban leh bakla kumba la leh u Balaam; bad kum u Kora kin sa ïap-duh ïap-dam ha ka jingïaleh pyrshah.

Ki pynthohbria ïa ki jingkhawai jong phi, namar kim lehraiñ ban shongshit buaid, ban pynbyrngia sahuh ïa lade. La kynting ïa ki ha ka lyer kum ki lyoh kiba khlem slap. Ki long kum ki dieng bymseisoh ba la rat noh myntlang, kiba la ïap arsien;
kum ki khiedew duriaw kiba lamwir, kiba seityrtho ïa la ki jinglehraiñ; ne kum ki ’lursiat kiba noh jlang arsut shapoh ka jingdum synñia bakhlem kut ba la pynap ïa ki.
Dei ïa kine ruh ba u Enokh, hynñiew pateng briew hadien u Adam, u la ïathuh lypa, “Hei, u Trai U la wan ryngkat bad la ki angel byllien bah

ban tian-bishar ïa baroh, bad ban pynrem ïa ki ’riewbymman baroh na ka bynta ki kam dakaid jong ki, kiba ki la leh da ka jingsniew ka bakhraw, bad na ka bynta ki ktien runar baroh kiba kito ki nongpop khlemblei ki la kynnoh beiñ pyrshah ïa U.”
Kine ki long ki ’riewkynshdut kiba tang ka thnum suda; ki pynhun katba kwah brai; ki kren kyr-eit heng heng bad ki pynroh ïa ki briew ban ïoh jingmyntoi ïa lade.
Phi dei ban kynmaw, ko ba-ieid eh, ïa ki ktien kiba la kren lypa da ki apostol jong u Trai jong ngi u Jisu Khrist.
Ki la ong ha phi ba, ha ki sngi bakhatduh kin wan ki nongpynthame kiban ïaid ha ka jingbymriewblei katkum ki jingkwahbrai jong ki.
Kine ki ’riewmrad, kibym don ïa u Mynsiem, ki pynmih ka jingïapait ïapra hapdeng jong phi.
Hynrei ma phi, ko ba-ieid eh, to pynkhlaiñ ïa lade ha ka jingngeit bakhuid tam jong phi, da kaba duwai ha u Mynsiem Bakhuid.
To ïaineh ha ka jingieid jong u Blei, katba phi khmih lynti ïa ka jingisynei u Trai jong ngi u Jisu Khrist shaduh ka jingim bymjukut.
To kynpham lem ïa kito kiba artatien;

ïa kiwei pat to pyllait-im, da kaba kynthet ïa ki na ka ding. Ïa ki katto katne ngut kiwei pat, to isynei, hynrei da ka jinghusiar; dei ban isih wat ïa ki jaiñphong kiba la jaboh da ki jingkwahbrai ka doh.
Ha Uta Uba lah ban sumar ïa phi ban ym kyllon, bad ban wanlam ïa phi ki bakhlem thohbria bad ki bakmen hakhmat ka burom jong U—
ha u Blei Bamarwei, u Nongpyllait jong ngi, lyngba u Jisu Khrist u Trai jong ngi, kan long ka burom, ka jingkhraw, ka jingsynshar bad ka bor, naduh bymjukut, mynta, bad junom bhor. Amen.
